{{Quote|My friend Jed, his wife and both his daughters have come home. Tana Moss, too.|[[Danbar Hue]]|<ref name="TOR:SaR">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Search and Rescue|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Tana Moss''' was living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns pirates]] raided several moisture farms near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] and took prisoners to be shipped as slaves off-world. [[Danbar Hue]] hired [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizens to attack the [[Twin Sun pirates base|pirate base]] and liberate the captives and in the end all prisoners, including Tana, were able to return to their homes safely.<ref name="TOR:SaR" />
